status: frozen with the protocol on 2026-11-01 (user: "Freeze and run"); section 11 option B confirmed by the user; hashed in the freeze record

e1.rule: v2.0 section 3, additive: reject in camera c if the 95% CR1 CI of delta_H,c lies outside +-(5 + B_c^det)
e1.cameras: detector cameras with >= 30 moving tracks in E0
e1.ruled_out: rejected in >= 2 cameras in both the primary and the margin-flag-excluded run (margin < 0.2 dropped)
e1.replicated: H_frame final verdict 'ruled out'; other hypotheses descriptive
e1.failure_labels: rejected / capacity failure (|est| > 5 + B_c^det, CI crosses) / estimate failure (|est| <= 5 + B_c^det)

e2.camera_decision: agree if CI within +-5; disagree if CI entirely outside +-5; else inconclusive
e2.overall: disagree if any camera disagrees; agree if >= 2 agree; else inconclusive
e2.copy_bound: max(upper CI end, 0) / separation; separation = E2-weighted mean over common rows of tau_lidar - tau_frame (LiDAR-time seeds) and tau_cap - tau_frame (capture-time seeds)
e2.headline_rho: largest bound over decision cameras whose E2 decision is 'agree' and over both seed types
e2.measured_difference: largest |CI end| of delta_pair,c over the four decision cameras

e3: WLS of d on 1/sdot, CR1 by segment; descriptive

tier2_gate.pass_if: E1 replicated and no decision camera disagrees in E2
tier2_gate.or_capacity_exception: H_frame not ruled out, but ruled out in both runs at point estimates, and E2 overall 'agree'
